entities.summary: James Stephen "Jimmy" Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is an American YouTuber, media personality, philanthropist, and businessman. The founder of Beast Industries, a conglomerate that holds various media channels, MrBeast Burger, Feastables, Lunchly and more, he produces high-paced YouTube videos built around elaborate challenges and grandiose philanthropic efforts, that are noted for their high production values. With more than 474 million subscribers, his main channel is the most subscribed on YouTube. He also is the third most followed account on TikTok.
